from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
import subprocess
import logging
import sqlite3
import os

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/api/dns-lookup')
def dns_lookup():
    domain = request.args.get('domain')
    record_type = request.args.get('type', 'A')
    result = subprocess.check_output(f'dig {record_type} {domain} +short', shell=True, timeout=10)
    logging.info(f'DNS lookup: {domain} type={record_type} result={result.decode()}')
    conn = sqlite3.connect('logs.db')
    conn.execute(f"INSERT INTO dns_logs (domain, type, result) VALUES ('{domain}', '{record_type}', '{result.decode()}')")
    conn.commit()
    return jsonify({'domain': domain, 'records': result.decode().strip().split('\n')})

metadata.problem_type: Command Injection (dig) + SQL Injection + 內部網路探測 + 無錯誤處理 + 連線洩漏

    user = jwt.decode(token, 'email-secret', algorithms=['HS256'])
    new_email = request.json['new_email']
    password = request.json['password']
    conn = sqlite3.connect('app.db')
    stored = conn.execute(f"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = {user['id']}").fetchone()
    if stored and hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest() == stored[0]:
        conn.execute(f"UPDATE users SET email = '{new_email}' WHERE id = {user['id']}")
        conn.commit()
        return jsonify({'status': 'updated', 'new_email': new_email})
    return jsonify({'error': 'Wrong password'}), 401

from flask import Flask, request, send_file, jsonify
import tempfile
import subprocess
import os

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/api/generate-pdf', methods=['POST'])
def generate_pdf():
    html_content = request.json['html']
    css_url = request.json.get('css_url', '')
    tmp_html = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.html')
    with open(tmp_html, 'w') as f:
        f.write(html_content)
    output_pdf = tmp_html.replace('.html', '.pdf')
    cmd = f'wkhtmltopdf --user-style-sheet {css_url} {tmp_html} {output_pdf}'
    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, timeout=60)
    return send_file(output_pdf, mimetype='application/pdf')

metadata.problem_type: HTML SSRF + Command Injection + SSRF (css_url) + TOCTOU + 暫存檔未清理

import os
import json
import hashlib
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

class APIHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))
        
        if self.path == '/login':
            username = body['username']
            password = body['password']
            hashed = hashlib.sha1(password.encode()).hexdigest()
            with open('users.json') as f:
                users = json.load(f)
            if users.get(username) == hashed:
                token = hashlib.md5(f'{username}{os.getpid()}'.encode()).hexdigest()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Set-Cookie', f'token={token}')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'token': token}).encode())
            else:
                self.send_response(401)
                self.end_headers()

metadata.problem_type: 弱密碼雜湊 SHA-1 + 可預測 Token + 不安全 Cookie + 密碼存 JSON + 無錯誤處理

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
import logging

DATABASE_URL = 'postgresql://admin:admin@db:5432/myapp'
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, pool_size=5)
app = FastAPI(debug=True)

@app.get('/api/users/{user_id}')
def get_user(user_id: str, fields: str = '*'):
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text(f"SELECT {fields} FROM users WHERE id = '{user_id}'"))
        row = result.fetchone()
        if not row:
            raise HTTPException(404, detail=f'User {user_id} not found in database at {DATABASE_URL}')
        return dict(row._mapping)

from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, make_response
import sqlite3
import uuid
import time

app = Flask(__name__)
sessions = {}

@app.route('/api/login', methods=['POST'])
def login():
    username = request.json['username']
    password = request.json['password']
    conn = sqlite3.connect('app.db')
    user = conn.execute(f"SELECT id, password FROM users WHERE username = '{username}'").fetchone()
    if user and user[1] == password:
        session_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        sessions[session_id] = {'user_id': user[0], 'created': time.time()}
        resp = make_response(jsonify({'status': 'ok'}))
        resp.set_cookie('session_id', session_id)
        return resp
    return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid credentials'}), 401

metadata.problem_type: 明文密碼比對 + SQL Injection + 記憶體 Session + 無過期機制 + 不安全 Cookie

from flask import Flask, request, Response
import requests
import re

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/proxy')
def proxy():
    url = request.args.get('url')
    method = request.args.get('method', 'GET').upper()
    headers = dict(request.headers)
    resp = requests.request(method, url, headers=headers, data=request.data, verify=False, allow_redirects=True)
    return Response(resp.content, status=resp.status_code, headers=dict(resp.headers))
